messages:
Morgan: Free dual-VESA monitor arm (holds two 27\" monitors). Includes 1x DisplayPort cable + 1x USB-C power passthrough cable. Moving out next week — pickup from SF office (Conference Room B) by Friday 3pm. Pics: https://imgur.com/example :seedling:
Alex: Interested! VESA 75/100? weight limit?
Morgan: Yes 75/100, rated ~8kg per arm. Arms tilt/swivel, gas-spring, no wobble. Tiny scuff under base only.
Jamie: I can take it if Sophie doesn't. Can grab Fri 2pm. @Sophie you still on the hunt?
Sophie: Maybe — depends on timing. If Jamie wants it, take it. If they bail I can do 4pm. Any tools needed to mount?
Morgan: Just a Phillips. I'll bring the small mounting screws but recommend you double-check with your monitor.
Alex: Quick Q — could I grab the DP cable even if the arm's claimed? My TB dock is flaky and I'm missing a spare.
Morgan: Sure, first-come for the cable. If you're grabbing cable only I'll leave it taped to the Post-it on the base.
Morgan: Also have a lightly used ergonomic desk chair (no armrests) — willing to let it go for a small donation to the office plants fund. :potted_plant:
OfficeBot: :information_source: Office reminder — items left in shared spaces must be labeled and removed within 48 hours. Please coordinate pick-up and keep walkways clear.
Jamie: DM sent, I'll confirm once I know my meeting schedule. Thanks Morgan! :thumbsup:
Sophie: If Jamie flakes, I can do 4pm pickup. Otherwise gl to Jamie.
Morgan: Sounds good. I'll label it "MORGAN - CLAIM" and put it in Conf Room B. Update here if plans change.
Alex: Thanks — I'll swing by to grab the cable if still there after lunch.
Jamie: Confirmed — I can make Fri 2pm. Leaving a note here in case timing shifts.
Morgan: Great, you're set. If anyone else wants the chair, let me know. Otherwise I'll drop the chair into the plants-fund box. Cheers!"
